metadata.hardware_requirements: computing server with NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU and Intel Xeon CPU E5-1650 (3.6 GHz, 6 cores)

nodes_source.source_quote: A series of simulation experiments based on real-world traffic data are conducted to evaluate the proposed approach.
nodes_source.description: Traffic volume data from the freeway connecting Qingdao and Huangdao through a tunnel in Shandong, China, covering mainline and on-ramp volumes from 7:50 a.m. to 9:00 a.m.
nodes_source.reproducibility_rationale: The data used to support the results of this study are available from the corresponding author upon request.

nodes_process.source_quote: Vehicle locations are extracted from the traffic video frames and are reformed as position matrices.
nodes_process.description: Extracts vehicle (x,y) coordinates from raw video. Converts coordinates into position matrices of size XxY. Performs down-sampling to reduce dimensions and stacks N consecutive matrices to capture vehicle dynamics.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, parameters for matrix dimensions provided, but specific extraction technique for coordinates from frames is not detailed.

nodes_process.source_quote: The algorithm for training the ramp metering policy is presented in Algorithm 1.
nodes_process.description: Trains a CNN-based Q-network using Deep Q-Learning with multitask learning to predict Q-values, mean speed, and queue length. Employs experience replay and a target network to stabilize training. Optimization uses the Adam algorithm with a combined loss function.
tools_mentioned: NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU version not stated
Intel Xeon CPU E5-1650 version not stated
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, architecture details, pseudocode, and all hyperparameters provided in Table 1.

nodes_process.source_quote: The proposed method is evaluated in SUMO, an open-source microscopic traffic simulator.
nodes_process.description: Evaluates the trained model in the SUMO simulator using a real-world freeway tunnel network. Compares performance against 'no control' and 'PI-ALINEA' baselines across 20 simulation experiments.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, environment and baseline parameters provided; SUMO version omitted.

nodes_process.source_quote: A perturbation analysis is conducted to evaluate the impact of information contained in video data.
nodes_process.description: Divides the control area into eight subareas and systematically removes information from each to observe the impact on travel time performance, proving the model utilizes multi-area visual data.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, logic and area division specified, but data removal mechanism is only loosely described.

nodes_sink.source_quote: The training process, presented in Figure 8... episode reward and mean travel time are both converged in 400,000 training frames
nodes_sink.description: Convergence curves for training, showing episode reward and mean travel time reaching stability over 1 million frames.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Training process and parameters (Table 1) specified, but raw empirical traffic data available only upon request.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 9 presents the Q1 (25%), Q2 (50%), and Q3 (75%) of the travel times in the mainline for three scenarios.
nodes_sink.description: Vehicle travel times in the mainline comparing no-control, PI-ALINEA, and DRL scenarios, showing quantiles over time.
nodes_sink.size_estimate: 1 plot with 3 series and confidence bands
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Simulation setup in SUMO is documented with calibrated parameters; traffic data availability is the main bottleneck.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Table 2 presents mean vehicle travel times in 20 simulation experiments.
nodes_sink.description: Mean travel times for 20 simulation trials across three control scenarios, including percentage improvement for PI-ALINEA and DRL.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Provides exact per-trial results, though specific random seeds for each of the 20 experiments are not stated.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 10 presents the temporal-spatial distribution of the mean speeds along the mainline.
nodes_sink.description: Speed heatmaps across time and distance for three scenarios, illustrating the extent and reduction of traffic congestion.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Consistent with travel time results in Fig 9; derived from standard SUMO output, assuming model parameters.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 11 presents the Q1, Q2, and Q3 of the queue lengths at the on-ramp in three scenarios.
nodes_sink.description: On-ramp queue length quantiles over time for No control, PI-ALINEA, and DRL.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Direct output from described simulation environment; performance claims match the visualized metrics.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 12 presents the mean queue lengths at the on-ramp and the red ratios
nodes_sink.description: Scatter plot showing the relationship between mean queue length and the proportion of red phase time.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Visualizes strategy differences; requires access to internal controller logs during simulation.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 13 presents the queue lengths at the on-ramp and the occupancy downstream of the merging area
nodes_sink.description: Time-series comparison of occupancy and queue length for PI-ALINEA and DRL scenarios.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Clear derivation from standard traffic metrics; depends on simulation reproducibility.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 14: Downstream volume in three scenarios.
nodes_sink.description: Boxplots of downstream traffic volume at 5-minute intervals for different control methods.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Summarizes raw simulation flow data; reproducible if the SUMO setup is exactly replicated.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 16 presents the box plot of travel time when the information of different subareas is removed
nodes_sink.description: Sensitivity analysis results showing mean travel time variations when masking visual input from specific geographic subareas.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Procedure for perturbation specified, but depends on trained model weights and specific subarea masks (Fig 15).
